name: Amanatsu Location
summary:
You visit a private resort on a southern island.
There, you find several girls enjoying their vacation...
The character creation feature has been revamped!
The feel remains the same, but even more beautiful girls await your encounter!

In addition to normal communication, you can tease them with massages and water guns, and sometimes share intimate moments to deepen your bond with each other.
You can fully enjoy a sweet and stimulating summer!
